calendarNote: 90-day calendar started 2026-10-06. Days 1-30: one app module a day. Days 31-60: guides (80G/12A, CSR-1, FCRA, registration). Days 61-90: how-to and recaps. Short at 12:30 PM IST, lesson at 6:30 PM IST.

days.hook: Grants for your NGO, in one place
points: Open impact-connect.in and tap Funding
Filter grants by state, sector and amount
Save a grant to follow its deadlines
Browse live CSR opportunities from companies
Check eligibility before you apply
Keep your 80G and 12A details ready
Search central and state schemes in one list
Read who can apply and what documents you need
Save schemes to revisit before the deadline

days.hook: Find volunteers who actually show up
points: Post your volunteer need in two minutes
Volunteers near you see it first
Track sign-ups from your dashboard

days.hook: Stuck on compliance? Ask an expert
points: Open the Experts door on Impact Connect
Find people who know FCRA, 80G and CSR-1
Send your question directly, free

days.hook: Donate to verified NGOs in your state
points: Every NGO on Impact Connect is verified first
Pick a cause you care about
Donate directly - no middleman cut
Open Learn from the home screen
Short lessons on fundraising and compliance
Come back daily - new lessons keep coming

days.hook: Your old things can fund a cause
points: List items you no longer need on Daan
NGOs request what they can use
Hand it over and see where it went
